Malley criticizes the inconsistent US objectives in the region, noting a progression from regime change to nuclear and missile program containment, then to control over the Strait of Hormuz, and now seemingly aiming to keep it closed. Malley says that the only option the US has to negotiate with Iran is to incentivize Iran with guarantees of no attacks and economic relief. title: Trump Reverts to Economic Squeeze of ‘Entrenched’ Iranian Regime
title_cn: 特朗普恢复对“根深蒂固”的伊朗政权的经济挤压
summary: The US military campaign against Iran has so far failed to force the regime to capitulate. The Trump administration is betting once again that suffocating economic pressure will do the job.

title: S&P 500 Wins Continue, Atlas Merchant Invests in Edge Focus | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/12/2026
title_cn: 标准普尔 500 指数持续上涨，Atlas Merchant 投资 Edge Focus |彭博商业周刊日报 8/12/2026
summary: Bloomberg's Mike McKee breaks down Wednesday's subdued inflation report, putting pressure on the fed following weak jobs numbers. Then, iCapital Global Investment Strategist Dan Suzuki also talks CPI report and the S&P 500 set to post its 4th consecutive quarter of growth. Plus, CEO of Atlas Merchant Capital Bob Diamond announces a new investment partnership alongside Co-Founder & CEO of Edge Focus Elliott Lorenz. Finally, London School of Economics Lecturer Rebecca Homkes talks about how CEO's are dealing with geopolitical and market shocks. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: USDA Says Argentine Beef That Missed Inspection Is Recalled
title_cn: 美国农业部表示召回漏检的阿根廷牛肉
summary: Nearly 30,000 pounds of Argentine beef that wasn’t fully inspected before being distributed in Texas and Florida are being recalled, the US Department of Agriculture said.
